text:
Ryan Hartman's name was all over the Dylan Larkin trade talk. Heavy.com reported a Wild offer that included him, and Hockey Wilderness asked what's next for him. Larkin went to Montreal on Monday, so Hartman stays, for now, on a team with points in 14 straight.

His own season has been uneven. He scored twice against Boston and shut them down, as Yahoo Sports put it, but has three goals and eight points in 25 games, and Minnesota takes only 40% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), almost 16 points worse than without him. That is unusual for him: Evolving-Hockey had him in the 89th percentile for driving play last season, and he scored 23 goals. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking shows him carrying the puck in on 57% of entries. Our range has him around 15 goals. With the trade talk settled, watch whether his game settles too.
